summary: The finished test checks whether an async task result has finished set to True; it works on normal tasks but warns.
questions: How do I wait until an async job is done?
Can I use the finished test on a non-async task?

answer_card.title: finished test (async)
answer_card.answer_md: `result is finished` is true when an async status result has `finished: true`. Typically used with `async_status` and `until:`. Works on regular tasks but issues a warning.
